a: जंभः — [जभ्-अच्-नुम्] 1 The jaws (usually in pl.). --2 A tooth. --3 Eating. --4 Biting asunder. --5 A part, portion. --6 A quiver. --7 The chin. --8 Yawning, gaping. --9 N. of a demon killed by Indra. --10 One who devours a demon. --11 Explanation, interpretation. --12 The citron tree. --Comp. --अरातिः, --द्विष्, --भेदिन्, --रिपुः epithets of Indra. --अरिः {1} fire. {2} Indra's thunderbolt. {3} Indra.
जंभका, जंभा, जंभिका — A yawn, gaping.
जंभक — a. 1 Eating, devouring. --2 Killing, crushing; destroying. --3 Biting asunder. --4 Explaining, interpreting. --5 Opening, expanding. --6 Yawning. --कः A lime or citron.
जंभलः — = जंभरः. --ला A female Rākṣasī (by meditating on whom women are said to become pregnant).
जंभनं — Sexual intercourse.
जंभ(भी)रः — The lime or citron tree.
जंभिन् — m. The citron tree.

जंघा — [जंघन्यते कुटिलं गच्छति हन् यङ्लुकि अच् पृषो˚; cf. Uṇ. 5. 31] 1 Leg from the ankle to the knee, the shank. --2 The upper part of the leg, the part about the loins. --3 A part of a bedstead. --Comp. --करः, --करिकः, --कारः, --कारिकः a runner, courier, an express. --त्राणं an armour for the legs.
जंघाल — a. [जंघा वेगवती अस्त्यस्य लच्] Running swiftly, rapid. --लः 1 A courier. --2 A deer, an antelope.
जंघिल — a. [जंघ-इलच्] Running swiftly, rapid, quick.
जंबालः — 1 Mud. --2 Moss. --3 The Ketaka plant.
जंबालिनी — A river.
जंबीरः — The citron tree. --रं A citron.
जंबूमत् — m. 1 A mountain. --2 A monkey. --ती A heavenly nymph.
जंबु-बू — f. The rose apple tree and its fruit. --Comp. --खंडः, --द्वीपः, --पर्वतः N. of one of the seven continents surrounding the mountain Meru. --नदी one of the seven heavenly rivers.
जंबु(बू)कः — (की f.) 1 A jackal. --2 A low man. --3 The rose apple tree. --4 An epithet of Varuṇa.

जंबुलः — [जंबुं तन्नामफलं लाति ला-क] 1 A kind of tree (= जंबू q. v.). --2 The Ketaka plant. --लं Jest or jesting compliments addressed to the bride and the bridegroom by the friends and female relatives of the bridegroom (or of the bride). --Comp. --मालिका the same as above.
जंगालः — A ridge of earth running along the edge of a field to collect water and to form a passage over it, land-mark.
जंगल — a. [गल्-यङ्-अच् पृषो˚] Desert, waste. --लः, --लं Flesh, meat. --लं 1 A desert, dreary ground, waste land. --2 A thicket, forest. --3 A secluded or unfrequented place.

जंगम — a. [गम्-यङ् अच्] 1 Moving, living, moveable (opp. immovable स्थावर); चिताग्निरिव जंगमः R. 15. 16; शोकाग्निरिव जंगमः Mv. 5. 20; Ms. 1. 41. --2 Derived from living beings. --मं A moveable thing; R. 2. 44. --Comp. --इतर a. immovable. --कुटी an umbrella.
जंगुलं — Poison, venom.

m: जंह् Intens. 3. sg. जङ्गहे, to move quickly, sprawl, kick, RV. i, 126, 6;
जंह् [cf. अभि-वि-; जघन, जङ्घा; Goth. gagg-an; Lith. zeng-ti.]
जंहस् n. moving, going, course, vi, 12, 2

a: जंजन — a. [जन्-यङ् लुक्-अच् पृषो˚] 1 Being born again. --2 Burning.
जंजपूक — a. Muttering prayers repeatedly. --कः An ascetic, or devotee (who mutters prayers); cf. P. III. 2. 166.
जंपती — m. du. [जाया च पतिश्च] Husband and wife; cf. दंपती and जायापती.

m: जंस् cl. 1. 10. ˚सति, ˚सयति, to protect, Dhātup. xxxii, 127; to liberate, ib.
a: जंस् — {c10c} P. (जंसयति) 1 To protect. --2 To liberate, release, set free.

जंतुः — [जन्-तुन्] 1 A creature, a living being, man; Ś. 5. 2; Ms. 3. 77. --2 The (individual) soul. --3 An animal of the lowest organization. --4 People, mankind. --Comp. --कंवुः {1} a snail's shell. {2} a snail. --घ्नः {1} the citron. {2} a snail. --फलः the Udumbara tree.
जंतुका — Lac.
जंतुमती — The earth.
